learning_objective: 🎯 Let's become art detectives who know how to observe paintings closely, uncover hidden meanings, and share helpful feedback!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we look at a painting, we should take our time! Notice the bright colors, the hidden shapes in the corners, and try to guess what story the artist is telling.
A review is sharing our thoughts on art. We use a sandwich trick: say something you love, give one gentle idea to make it better, and end with another happy compliment!
Art makes us feel things! A blue painting might make us feel calm, while a bright red one feels exciting. It is wonderful to talk about how art changes our mood.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Host a Home Art Gallery!
fun_activity.instructions: Pin your recent drawings on the wall. Invite your family to walk around the gallery and give a friendly review of their favorite piece using the feedback sandwich!

quick_recap: ⭐ Looking closely at art helps us find secret details and fun stories.
⭐ Giving a friendly review helps artists learn and grow.
⭐ Art is powerful because it can change our feelings and moods.
